method: Independent exact-GLB indexed-topology connected-component extraction followed by 3D convex hull volume and separating-axis theorem (both hull facet normals plus every hull triangulation edge cross-product). Pairwise test is limited to clast-versus-clast solids, not intentional clast-host embedding. SAT is exact only where components match their convex hulls; the report records hull/mesh volume ratio to expose nonconvex components. Positive axis overlap required on every axis; 1e-8m contact tolerance.
